sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Review of the grammar and language systems from Units 1–9.

Ő Károly needs no verb at all — identity drops the copula in the 3rd person — but a barátok itt vannak does use vannak, because here it means 'are located', not 'are [some category]'. The zero-copula rule only touches identity and description, never location or existence.
